_comment: The Jellyfin OIDC plugin this deployment runs, pinned. Read by
init/init.py (so a fresh install comes up with the SSO button).

this the only record of what was installed was a zip in /tmp. Measured on
exactly the assembly inside Ezeqielle/jellyfin-plugin-oidc v1.0.10's
hashes are asserted, so a swap to a different build is a finding rather
provides: the Cerulean Authentik button on Jellyfin's login page, with group-to-library RBAC
